clue.text: Queen picked up regalia that's supplied by 8

indicators.note: in a down clue, picked up means lifted, so the word for queen is read bottom to top

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual crossword queen
regalia are finery, ceremonial dress and trappings

explanation.surface: The Queen collects her crown jewels, as though they came from some supplier.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is WELL WELL; oil wells feed a refinery. 'Picked up' turns ER upwards to RE.
explanation.definitionFit: An oil plant processes crude that is pumped from oil wells, so it is what those wells supply.

clue.text: 13 letters found in river near Dome?

indicators.note: thirteen is half of the twenty-six letters, so only the front half of the word for all the letters is kept

parts.note: the alphabet is the full set of letters

explanation.surface: A puzzling riddle about a river beside some famous dome, spelt in thirteen letters.
explanation.walkthrough: The alphabet has 26 letters, so '13 letters' is half of ALPHABET: its first four letters. Coleridge's Kubla Khan has the sacred river Alph flowing by the stately pleasure-dome.
explanation.definitionFit: In Coleridge's poem Kubla Khan, the sacred river runs beside Xanadu's pleasure-dome, hence the literary question mark.

clue.text: Husband's at home perhaps sleeping late

indicators.note: perhaps hints that sleeping is one way of being in bed, so the husband at home goes inside the bed

parts.note: someone sleeping is likely in bed
at home means in

explanation.surface: A husband lies at home asleep well into the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is': husband is at home, H IN, and sleeping puts him in BED.
explanation.definitionFit: Running late means being behind schedule, so the two words are interchangeable as adjectives.

clue.text: Unfinished metallic compound hasn't been beaten

indicators.note: a compound mixes ingredients, so the letters are mixed up
unfinished means the word metallic loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A chemistry note on a half-made metal compound that has resisted all attack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unfinished' drops the C of METALLIC, leaving METALLI; 'compound' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-time record is the best ever, one nobody has yet surpassed.

clue.text: Sword wound — writer's impressed with it

indicators.note: impressed means pressed into, so the pieces go inside the wound

parts.note: a scar is the mark of a wound
the writer's is the setter's I'M, 'I am'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sword wound, with the writer stamped by the blade.
explanation.walkthrough: IM and IT together go into SCAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved oriental blade is one kind of sword.

clue.text: Use it to change platforms or pay for game

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay for it
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Advice to a commuter about crossing platforms, or about paying for a game.
explanation.definitionFit: At a railway station, an elevated walkway over the tracks lets travellers cross from one platform to another.

clue.text: 8 captivated English actor-director

indicators.note: captivated means holding something captive within, so E goes inside

parts.note: 8 is a pair of wells, so the plural word

explanation.surface: An English actor-director charms the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is WELL WELL, read as two wells, WELLS.
explanation.definitionFit: Orson Welles directed and starred in Citizen Kane, a famous American actor-director.

clue.text: Healthy source? Would you believe it!

parts.note: being well means being healthy
a well is a source of water

explanation.surface: An astonished cry at finding a spa spring of good health.
explanation.definitionFit: The doubled exclamation is an expression of surprise, like 'fancy that!'

clue.text: Approved school clothes altered

indicators.note: clothes is a verb here, the school dressing around the approval

parts.note: a coed is a coeducational school
OK means approved

explanation.surface: An approved school's uniforms have been changed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Approved school' reads as the old British reform school for young offenders, but the two words separate.
explanation.definitionFit: Cooked books or figures have been falsified, that is, tampered with.

clue.text: Almost knock over hot drink

indicators.note: knocking over upends it, so the word for drink is turned back to front

parts.note: gin is a drink
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone very nearly spills a hot drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigh is an old word for near, and it survives in 'well nigh', meaning nearly.

clue.text: How pals get on, working impatiently after power cut

indicators.note: working means operating differently, so the letters are rearranged
cut means removed, so P is taken out

parts.note: P is the symbol for power

explanation.surface: Friends getting along while impatiently working after a power cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut' takes P from IMPATIENTLY, leaving IMATIENTLY, which 'working' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Close friends relate closely and personally, as on familiar terms.

clue.text: See old Irish duke getting acquainted

parts.note: V stands for vide, Latin for see
Erse is an old name for the Gaelic language of Ireland

explanation.surface: An old Irish duke is seen meeting people.
explanation.definitionFit: To be versed in a subject is to be familiar with it.

clue.text: Half of 8 women and one pair of males split one by one

indicators.note: split means broken apart, with the other pieces put into the gap

parts.note: singly means one at a time
I is the Roman numeral one
M is male, so a pair is two of them

explanation.surface: Half a group of women and a male couple go their separate ways one at a time.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is WELL WELL, so half of it is 'well'.
explanation.definitionFit: Things going smoothly and without trouble go well.

clue.text: He drives doctor to sightseer, avoiding hairpin

parts.note: MO is a medical officer

indicators.note: avoiding means keeping out, so the letter is removed

parts.note: a tourist goes sightseeing
a hairpin bend is shaped like a U

explanation.surface: A man drives a doctor to a tourist, steering clear of a hairpin bend.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who drives a car is a motorist.

clue.text: 8 go by in Serpentine with Juliet

indicators.note: with puts Juliet together with the rearranged letters, here among them
serpentine means winding, so the letters twist into a new order

parts.note: Juliet is J in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone strolls by the Serpentine with Juliet.
explanation.walkthrough: The Serpentine is a lake in London's Hyde Park; here it means winding. 8 is WELL WELL, an exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are old-fashioned cries of surprise, mild interjections of astonishment.

clue.text: Start to get a faint glow from this?

definitions.text: Start to get a faint glow from this?

indicators.note: start to means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: slight means faint

explanation.surface: A question about what yields a faint glow at first.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas-fuelled lamp gave Victorian streets a soft, dim illumination.

clue.text: During 10, leader of Red Rum walked on

indicators.note: during means within, so the pieces go inside

parts.note: here 10 is the number, not a cross-reference

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter

parts.note: rum means odd

explanation.surface: The famous racehorse Red Rum trod the turf at ten.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 looks like a reference to 10-across; it is just TEN. Red Rum was a celebrated Grand National winner.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground that has been trodden has been walked over.

clue.text: Grace sculpted angel in Eastern church

indicators.note: in places the shaped angel inside the other pieces

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: sculpted means shaped anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A graceful sculpted angel stands in an Eastern church.
explanation.definitionFit: Elegance is refinement and poise, as is grace.

clue.text: 8 Spanish calls

parts.note: SP is the abbreviation for Spanish
rings means telephone calls

explanation.surface: A Spanish voice makes some calls.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 here is WELL WELL read as wells.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural water sources rising from the ground are wells.

clue.text: Bus crashed during strike, a sign of 26?

indicators.note: during means inside, so the rearranged letters sit within the strike

parts.note: to thump is to strike

indicators.note: crashed means wrecked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bus crashed during a strike; is this a lucky sign?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crashed' turns BUS into BSU. 26 is GOOD LUCK.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising a thumb is a gesture of approval or encouragement, wishing someone well.

clue.text: Veiled female hugs current churchman

indicators.note: a female who hugs holds someone in her arms, so the other pieces sit inside her

parts.note: a hen is a female bird
I is the symbol for electric current
DD is a Doctor of Divinity

explanation.surface: A veiled woman embraces a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: Something veiled is concealed from view.

clue.text: Guy had hauled in fish that's hooked

indicators.note: hauled in means pulled inside, so the fish goes within

parts.note: he'd means he had, guy being he
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: An angler hauls in a hooked fish.
explanation.walkthrough: In golf, a hooked or heeled shot comes off the heel of the club and veers left.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf ball struck off the club's heel swerves sharply left, a kind of mishit.

clue.text: I love leaving Lothario quivering

indicators.note: quivering means shaking, so the letters are rearranged
leaving means taken out of the word

parts.note: love is zero, O, as in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone confesses their love for a quivering seducer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaving' takes I and O from LOTHARIO, leaving LOTHAR; 'quivering' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose woman would express that she adores a womanizer, with a nod to a seducer's mistress.

clue.text: Papers by top medical unit (if that's the right name)

parts.note: ID means identity papers
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
taken as written
i.e. means that is

explanation.surface: Papers for a top medical unit, if the label is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A label used to pick something out is a tag by which it is known.

clue.text: School boss deceived about origin of education

indicators.note: about means around, enclosing the next piece

parts.note: had means deceived, as in 'you've been had'

indicators.note: origin of means the first letter

explanation.surface: A deceitful headteacher lies about where education began.
explanation.definitionFit: A headteacher is commonly called the head, the person in charge of a school.

clue.text: Dig round lake, one of 8

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the lake goes inside

parts.note: to hoe is to dig

explanation.surface: Digging around a lake for a well.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is WELL WELL; a well is a hole in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A well is a shaft bored into the ground, a type of pit.

clue.text: Stop hospital hoarding drug for condition

indicators.note: hoarding means keeping inside, so the drug is held within

parts.note: to halt is to stop
E is ecstasy

explanation.surface: A call to stop a hospital stockpiling a drug for some ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's state of wellbeing is their physical condition.

clue.text: Leave old dear clutching large fortune

parts.note: to go is to leave

indicators.note: clutching means holding within

parts.note: duck is a British term of endearment, like dear

explanation.surface: An old darling departs, holding on to a big fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' is an affectionate British form of address, especially in the Midlands and North.
explanation.definitionFit: Luck and fortune both mean chance; the good kind is what one wishes others.
